title: Siri AI Settlement: Apple Won't Begin Paying Customers Until Next Year
snippet: In May, Apple agreed to pay $250 million to settle a U.S. class action lawsuit over Siri AI's delayed launch, and eligible iPhone users could receive up to a $95 payout. Apple's settlement received preliminary approval last month, but final approval is not expected until next year, according to a new court document. title: Trump’s Big Bend Border Project Paused After Bulldozers Arrive
snippet: The Trump administration is pausing work on a border security project inside Texas’ Big Bend National Park, days after bulldozers began clearing land in one of the least-crossed stretches of the US-Mexico border.

title: Puerto Rico Democrat Seeks Answers on Water Loss, Federal Funds
snippet: Puerto Rico’s representative on Capitol Hill wants to know why the island’s state-run sewer authority loses approximately 60% of the water it produces before it reaches homes, despite federal investment from Washington as far back as 2021 to upgrade its ailing infrastructure system.
